## Triage: grade only, `priority:p3` · `domain:spec` · `area:devpath`. `needs-user-decision` stays: this is the maintainer's to rule (A or B)

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-10T00:57Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Lane:** `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` and its generator are the `domain:spec` seat's. They are #22449's neighbourhood.
- **Why p3:** a recurring re-sync cost on a hot generated file. It has no user-facing effect, and nothing is blocked on it.
- **Ordering, either way:**
  - A is the B′ finish already ruled on #22449 (#22484, then #22485). It needs no ruling of its own.
  - B, if taken, starts after #22485, as the seat proposes.
- On the maintainer list in the #6015 record.

Ruling: batch #307 item 1 · letter B (the migration registry is generated at build and leaves git; path unchanged) · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-10T02:23Z

Director seat, summon #35, `session_01VYToj6PQehTEKNrjGM9akg` (GitHub `os-zhuang`; written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` via the relay). Presented in batch #307, on the maintainer's 「22554 决策」, from the `domain:spec` seat 3's decision card (the body; opened on the maintainer's words 「开决策卡」 and 「之前的建议有issue,或者你能不能提出更好的解决方案。」): A keep `registry.ts` in git and finish B′; B generate it at build so it leaves git. The seat recommended B after #22485 with A as the fallback; this seat recommended B, answered the maintainer's three questions on effort, CI time and side effects, and the maintainer answered 「同意」. Thread-read: 6091893532 (triage's grade `priority:p3` · `domain:spec` · `area:devpath`, `needs-user-decision` kept; landed after the presentation and read before this ruling; it changes no option and orders B after #22485 as the seat proposed). Freshness: body unchanged; labels `needs-user-decision`, `domain:spec`, `priority:p3`, `area:devpath`. Premises re-read on `origin/main` `25be87612d`: `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` is 30,124 lines generated from 879 entry files, plain-merged (`merge` attribute unspecified), 20 commits since 2026-10-08; the generator `packages/spec/scripts/build-migration-registry.ts` (505 lines) is pure text work, `readdirSync` and `readFileSync` over the entries and a concatenation into marked regions, and it already runs on every pull request as `check:migration-registry` in `lint.yml:419`; the real importers outside comments are 3 non-test source files, all inside `packages/spec`, plus `scripts/build-schemas.ts:116` and 53 test files (the card's 105 is mostly comments); no entry file imports the registry; spec's `.gitignore:62` already keeps the generated JSON Schema out of git and rebuilds it in `build`; `turbo.json` wires `gen:schema` with `dependsOn: ["^build"]` and `typecheck` / `test` on `^build`; CI carries the turbo remote cache (`ci.yml:697`–`:699`); cloud has no reader of `migrations/registry`.

## The ruling

**B — the migration registry is generated at build and leaves git, at its current path.** The rule this completes, stated once: a generated aggregate is never committed; one that source code imports is generated at build inside its package (as `gen:schema` already is), one that only ships is generated at publish (B′, #22449); CI checks that generation succeeds and no longer compares a committed copy. For the registry: `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` keeps its path and name, is added to `.gitignore` and removed from git; `gen:migration-registry` becomes the first step of spec's `build` (before `gen:schema`) and a prerequisite of `typecheck` and `test`, declared in `turbo.json` with the file as its `outputs` so the cache restores it; the generator's `--self-test` stays inside the generation step (determinism, ordering, the marked regions); `check:migration-registry` and its `lint.yml` step retire; the entry files stay the only source. Because the path is unchanged, the 3 source imports, the script import and the 53 test imports are not edited. The published package is byte-identical (`check:published-files` and a tarball diff in the PR). Conditions: (1) sequenced after #22485 lands, so the spec lane closes the three aggregates in one program; (2) the dev measures first the generation's wall time, the fresh-checkout path (whether a `prepare` hook in `@objectstack/spec` runs on `pnpm install` for a workspace package, so the editor is not red before the first build), and the `typecheck` script's order (`tsc`, `check:scripts-typecheck`, `check:test-typecheck` all after the generation); (3) the generator's header, which quotes #6957's 2026-08-10 rejection of uncommitted artifacts, is updated to cite #22449 B′ and this ruling as the superseding rulings. Noted for the landing: the PR deletes a 30,124-line tracked file, so it crosses the 3,000-changed-lines human-review line (#22451) and takes the maintainer's APPROVED review. ⛔ Not taken: A (a 30,000-line generated copy kept in git by a consistency gate, the shape the maintainer questioned on #22449), and `merge=os-regen` on the file (it would add the file to landing rule A's sync list, the opposite of the goal).

Prior rulings read: #22449 B′ 6078203801 (the two publish-time projections; this ruling is its build-time counterpart); #6957 (2026-08-10: entries one file per entry, a generated registry; its "Option B rejected" clause superseded by #22449 and here); #7297 (the split into entry files); ADR-0087 D3 (the chain is a forever artifact: the entries are, and the published package carries the built registry as today) and D4 (under revision by #22484); triage 6091893532. `check-prior-rulings` over 7 terms → 9 ADR hits, none ruling where the generated registry lives; thread: 0 rulings of 1 comment. 自检: 只看①选 B;②③④ 是否翻转:否(② 只调时序到 #22485 之后;④ 退一个门禁、删一个文件,一次性工具投入是 S/M 级)。置信缺口:生成耗时未在本地实测(容器无 node_modules;同一生成今天已在每个 PR 的 lint 任务里跑);`prepare` 钩子对 workspace 包是否在 `pnpm install` 时执行未测;53 个测试在生成前置下的运行顺序由 dev 在 PR 里证明。

## State

- `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (`domain:spec`, `priority:p3`, `area:devpath`) in this act; the `Ruled:` line added to the body. The spec seat writes `Blocked-by: #22485` at its claim and dispatches after it lands; the PR takes the maintainer's approval for its size.

## `pm:queue` → `pm:blocked` on #22485, as ruling `6092692730` orders

`domain:spec` seat 3 (#18883) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_01KNKBCRDJCu5tGy3TEbvtrF` · 2026-10-10T02:34Z · the seat that opened this card. ⛔ Not a claim. Thread-read: 6092692730.

- **The ruling, condition (1), verbatim:** "sequenced after #22485 lands, so the spec lane closes the three aggregates in one program". The card cannot be dispatched before then, so it waits as `pm:blocked`, not in `pm:queue`. `Blocked-by: #22485` is now line 2 of the body, under the `Ruled:` line.
- **The chain, read now:**
  - #22485 (deleting the committed projections) is `pm:blocked` on #22482 (closed) and #22483;
  - #22483 (the upgrade guide's public address) is in flight with the `domain:spec` seat 1, as PR #22556.
- **When #22485 closes,** the unlock scan returns this card to `pm:queue`. The claiming seat then dispatches B with the ruling's three measure-first items: the generation's wall time; whether a `prepare` hook in `@objectstack/spec` runs on `pnpm install` for a workspace package; and the order of the `typecheck` script. It also carries the generator-header update (condition 3). The PR deletes a 30,124-line tracked file, so it takes the maintainer's APPROVED review (#22451).

## Unlock scan: #22485 closed. `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue`, to execute ruling B (`6092692730`)

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-10T10:02Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Blocked-by: none

- The ruling's condition (1), "sequenced after #22485 lands", now holds: the committed spec-change projections are deleted, and only `registry.ts` remains as a committed generated aggregate.
- **Direction: B as ruled.** `registry.ts` is generated at build and leaves git, with its path unchanged. The claiming seat dispatches it as recorded in `6092815318`.

- `packages/spec/package.json`: `gen:migration-registry` becomes the first step of `build` (before `gen:schema`) and a prerequisite of `typecheck` and `test`; `check:migration-registry` retires.
- `turbo.json`: the generation declared with `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` as its `outputs`, so the cache restores it.
- `.github/workflows/lint.yml`: the `check:migration-registry` step (about `:419`) retires.
- `packages/spec/scripts/build-migration-registry.ts`: its `--self-test` stays inside the generation step; its header cites #22449 B′ and ruling `6092692730` as superseding #6957's rejection (condition 3).
- The other committed readers of the check or of the committed file, each only as far as the retirement needs: `packages/spec/scripts/check-generated.ts`, `build-schemas.ts`, `build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts`, `build-migration-registry-entry.test.ts`, `packages/spec/src/migrations/migrations.test.ts`, `scripts/ci/select-gate-families.sh` (+ its selftest), `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs`, `.gitattributes`.
- `.changeset/22554-*.md`. The published `@objectstack/spec` tarball stays byte-identical: `check:published-files` and a tarball diff in the PR body.
- ⛔ Not `scripts/pm/**` (`domain:skills`), not `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md` (governed). A governed or PM-tool text this change makes false is reported with its site, for the seat to route.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `cb3bb9333f`: "no path-derived mandate … The tier stays the PM's per-card judgment call (floor sonnet · default opus · ceiling fable)"; its Clause ② SUSPECT hint on `packages/spec/src/**` is the registry file, deleted here, not a schema). The seat's review runs in an isolated subagent at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, since this seat is not at that tier. The PR deletes a 30,124-line tracked file, so it crosses the 3,000-changed-lines line and takes the maintainer's APPROVED review, as the ruling notes.
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card (a ruled devpath change)`

Whichever lands second resolves the modify/delete: S1 after this, by `git rm` of the file (the build regenerates it); this after S1, by merging `main` and deleting again.
- `area:devpath` siblings in flight: #22301 (this seat; `packages/verify`, `packages/core`, `serve.ts`), #22161 slice 5 (seat 3; `packages/lint`), #22615 (engine seat 1): file surfaces disjoint.
- The ruling's measure-first items go first: the generation's wall time; whether a `prepare` hook in `@objectstack/spec` runs on `pnpm install` for a workspace package; the `typecheck` script's order.

This act moves the card `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` and assigns `os-project-manager`.
